field.label: Enabled
field.help: Read this switch. Untick to keep its settings without polling it.

field.label: Name
field.help: Shown in the plugin pages, for example "Rack" or "Garage". Leave empty to use the name configured on the switch.

field.label: Address
field.help: IP address or host name of the switch, for example 10.0.1.2. HTTPS is used. The switch must be in local management mode (its own web login page is reachable); cloud-managed switches have no local login and are read through a cloud account instead.

field.label: User name
field.help: An account of the switch web interface. Read access is enough for monitoring; changes need an administrator account. A dedicated account makes the plugin sessions easy to recognise in the switch log.

field.label: Password
field.help: Stored in the firewall configuration and in a file readable only by root. It is sent to the switch RSA-encrypted, the same way its web interface does.

field.label: Verify certificate
field.help: Check the HTTPS certificate of the switch. Leave it off for the factory self-signed certificate.

field.label: Uplink ports
field.help: Ports of this switch that lead towards the firewall, for example 1/51. Addresses learned on them are not listed as clients, and they are protected from changes (they cannot be switched off or reconfigured from the plugin). Leave empty for automatic detection: the port where the firewall's own MAC address is seen, or whose description mentions OPNsense, firewall, router, gateway or uplink. Links between monitored switches are found automatically.

field.label: Save after each change
field.help: Copy the running configuration to the startup configuration after every change, so it survives a restart of the switch. Untick to test changes first: they are lost at the next restart unless you press "Save configuration" on the Configuration page.
